n: ἐν (en) 'in' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
διανοίας (dianoias) 'mind' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of καρδίας (kardias) 'heart' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
Ἰησοῦ (Iēsou) 'Jesus' is only in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
κοινωνία (koinōnia) 'fellowship' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of οἰκονομία (oikonomia) 'administration' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, (dia Iēsou Christou) 'through Jesus Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, (tou kuriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou) 'of the Lord of us Jesus Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὑμῖν. (humin) 'in you.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
πρῶτον (prōton) 'first' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
λοιπὰ (loipa) 'rest of' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἡμῖν (hēmin) 'us' occurs in a few manuscripts (Tyn+Byz) instead of ὑμῖν.¶ (humin) 'you.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH+Treg+TR)
ὑμᾶς (humas) 'you' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH+Treg) instead of ἡμᾶς (hēmas) 'us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+TR+Byz)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'you' occurs in a few manuscripts (WH) instead of ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+Treg+TR+Byz)
πνεύματος (pneumatos) 'spirit' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of φωτὸς (phōtos) 'light [is]' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Θεοῦ (Theou) 'of God' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of Χριστοῦ.¶ (Christou) 'of Christ.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
ὑποτάσσεσθε (hupotassesthe) 'do submit yourselves' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἰδίοις (idiois) 'to [their] own' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἑαυτῶν (he'autōn) 'of your own' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
κύριος (kurios) 'Lord' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Χριστὸς (Christos) 'Christ' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἐκ τῆς σαρκός αὐτοῦ καί ἐκ τῶν ὀστέων αὐτοῦ. (ek tēs sarkos autou kai ek tōn osteōn autou) 'from the flesh of Him and from the of bones of Him.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ἀδελφοί μου, (adelphoi mou) 'brothers of mine' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
αἰῶνος (aiōnos) 'age' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
δέξασθαι (dexasthai) 'to receive' occurs in a few manuscripts (Byz) instead of δέξασθε (dexasthe) 'do take' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+TR)

ἀμήν πρός Εφέσιους ἐγράφη ἀπό Ῥώμης διά τυχικοῦ.¶ (amēn pros Ephesious egraphē apo Rhōmēs dia tuchikou) 'Amen. to Ephesian it was written from Rome through Tychicus.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
